name: Linux Systems Administration & Kernel Internals
description: Core Linux systems administration, systemd unit life-cycles, process management, storage LVM, and kernel capabilities
target_audience: Linux Systems Administrators, Infrastructure Engineers, and RHCSA/LFCS Candidates

steps.title: Linux Process States & Signals
steps.description: Master process hierarchy, fork/exec, signals (SIGTERM/SIGKILL), and zombie process cleanup.
concepts: Process States (R, S, D, Z, T)

steps.title: systemd Units, Timers & Service CrashLoops
steps.description: Configure custom unit files, systemd timers over cron, dependency ordering, and automated crash recovery.

steps.title: Linux Filesystems, LVM & Mounts
steps.description: Configure LVM volume groups, logical volumes, XFS/ext4 filesystems, and /etc/fstab automount resilience.

steps.title: Linux Permissions, Capabilities & SSSD
steps.description: Apply least-privilege POSIX ACLs, ambient Linux capabilities, and enterprise directory identity through SSSD.

steps.title: Kernel cgroups v2, OOM & Performance Diagnostics
steps.description: Diagnose system load, OOM killer invocations, cgroups v2 resource accounting, and strace/perf profiling.
